Aug 21

Custom OAuth scopes

Category
Product
Published
Aug 21

Give MCP clients precise, discoverable access to your API with custom OAuth scopes.

Aurora now gives you finer control over the access that MCP clients can request from your API. Define custom OAuth scopes in the Aurora Dashboard to match the actions and resources your API supports.

For example:

  • messages:read
  • tools:execute
  • resources/files:read
  • mcp_all

Assign only the scopes that each OAuth application needs. Separately, choose which scopes to advertise through Aurora's OAuth metadata so MCP clients can discover what your application supports.

Open the Scopes tab on the OAuth applications⁠ page to get started.

To enforce scopes in your API, verify each OAuth access token and check its granted scopes. See Verify OAuth tokens with Aurora.

Contributor
Kevin Wang
